title: Bug
description: One defect in the product, at <venture>/product/bugs/<id>.json. 'Stable' in the validation study is measured as no open P0 or P1 (node schema/bugs.mjs, naive bugs).

severity.description: P0 blocks use or loses data; P1 breaks a capability; P2 a workaround exists; P3 cosmetic

found_in.description: The version (or commit) it was found in

feedback.description: The feedback record it came from, if any
